name: addLayer
description: Add any type of layer to the map. Supports WMS, WMTS, WFS, GeoJSON, KML, XYZ, MVT, TMS, OGC API Features. Use 'type' for format, 'url' for service/data URL, 'name' for layer identifier. For GeoJSON provide url (the layer will be created with IDEE.layer.GeoJSON). For WMS/WMTS/WFS provide service URL and layer name.

type.description: Type of layer: WMS, WMTS, WFS, GeoJSON, KML, XYZ, MVT, TMS, OGCAPIFeatures

url.description: URL of the layer service or data file. Required for WMS, WMTS, WFS, XYZ, MVT, TMS, KML. Optional for GeoJSON if 'data' is provided.

name.description: Layer name/identifier from the service. For WMS/WMTS this is the layer name from the service. For WFS it is the typeName.

legend.description: Label to show in the map legend/layer tree. Defaults to 'name' if not provided.

transparent.description: Whether the layer background is transparent (WMS only)

format.description: Image format (e.g. 'image/png' for WMS/WMTS, 'application/json' for WFS)

data.description: Inline GeoJSON data as a JSON string (for GeoJSON type only, alternative to 'url')

matrixSet.description: Tile matrix set identifier (WMTS only, e.g. 'EPSG:25830')

version.description: Service version (e.g. '1.1.1' for WMS, '2.0.0' for WFS)

fit.description: If true, automatically zoom the map to fit the layer's extent after loading. The layer's getMaxExtent() is used to determine the extent.
